title: What Is El Niño? Here’s What It Means for Weather, Water, and Global Economy
summary: In plain language, it’s a region in the eastern-central tropical Pacific. Super El Niño isn’t an official term any meteorological agency uses, but scientists generally use it define any event where temperatures by a least 2 degrees Celsius above average.
